name: Bakonyszentiván (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bakonyszentiván: a crowned blue shield with a white bar, a wheel and a yellow charge.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
